dct_description_sm: A manuscript copy of a manuscript original.

A manuscript copy of a manuscript original. Pen-and-ink on tracing linen. Oriented with north to the bottom. In ink in different hand under title: water grant Mar 6 1839. In pen and ink on octagonal blue bordered label in lower right corner: 851 1839. Transferred from the USCGS January 15, 1914.
